arxiv-2111-06540.title: A Nonlocal Spectral Transfer Model and New Scaling Law for Scalar Turbulence
arxiv-2111-06540.creator: Ali Akhavan-Safaei 1,2, Mohsen Zayernouri 1,3
arxiv-2111-06540.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Ali Akhavan-Safaei 1,2, Mohsen Zayernouri 1,3. In this study, we revisit the spectral transfer model for the turbulent intensity in the passive scalar transport (under large-scale anisotropic forcing), and a subsequent modification to the scaling of scalar variance cascade is presented. From the modified spectral transfer model, we obtain a revised scalar transport model using fractional-order Laplacian operator that facilitates the robust inclusion of the nonlocal effects originated from large-scale anisotropy transferred across the multitude of scales in the turbulent cascade.

Tensor robust principal component analysis (RPCA), which seeks to separate a low-rank tensor from its sparse corruptions, has been crucial in data science and machine learning where tensor structures are becoming more prevalent. pmc-11430705.description: Impaired tumor cell antigen presentation contributes significantly to immune evasion. pmc-13501410.description: Embolism is known to occur in leaf venation networks as the leaf dries out.
